title: Ship stack-first autonomous agent site
description: Redesign toron.dev as the public map of the four-plane autonomous agent stack: toron owns signed transport and records, flywheel owns orchestration, beads owns work evidence, and chiebukuro owns knowledge and memory. Add the missing public routes, CSS-only crash/resume hero, build-time Mermaid explanations, generated-doc correctness checks, public install/version assets, metadata, analytics, and route smoke proof. Keep product guides canonical in toron/docs/guides instead of duplicating them.
close_reason: Shipped the stack-first autonomous agent site. Build, lint, route smoke, search, generated-doc, install, and metadata proofs are green. PRINCIPLES: prove-it-works — verified the real app artifact; foundational-thinking — modeled the four-plane ownership boundary before rendering it.
